$comment: Dated aliases for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §16.20). Event rows send the new name first, then the old one, with one detail; setting rows map the old attribute and property to the new; host-attribute rows (no "to") stay host attributes read by the browser or the base and are listed, refused by the shim on purpose; documentary rows ("shim": "none") record a rename the shim cannot serve.

aliases.note: the event of the trait field-inherit@1, declared in component.json as the shared event field-reset; the field sends sf-field-reset and the shim follows it with this dated name, same detail, one cancel
the getter shown returned the painted colour; shown is now the base value (a boolean) on every element, so the old meaning cannot be served beside it: read effectiveValue

aliases.section: rename plan R0 (ui-control RENAME-PLAN-2026-11-03), naming decision 2026-11-02
aliases.note: the element is sf-input-color; sf-color is a subclass defined beside it until the date
